description: This file implements the main React component for a comprehensive chess game interface, including game state management, move execution, AI integration, timers, draw offers, and UI interactions.

methods.name: chessFromFen
methods.description: Creates and optionally loads a FEN string into a new Chess.js instance.

methods.name: createNewGame
methods.description: Initializes and returns the default state object for a new game.

methods.name: computeCheckSquare
methods.description: Detects the king's square in check based on the current chess.js position.

methods.name: statusText
methods.description: Generates descriptive status text based on game state, including check, checkmate, stalemate, draw, and time flags.

methods.name: isPromotionMove
methods.description: Determines whether a move from 'from' to 'to' involves pawn promotion.

methods.name: clampTimerSeconds
methods.description: Ensures timer seconds are within valid bounds (10 to 3600 seconds).

methods.name: movePly
methods.description: Calculates the current move ply count based on chess.js history length.

methods.name: reducer
methods.description: Handles state transitions for the ChessGame component, including moves, game resets, draw offers, timers, AI play, and undo.
